description: Styles for the React frontend of an online Tic Tac Toe game, defining various colors, layout, and component styles.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Root component styles for centering and aligning the main application.

classes.name: game-container
classes.description: Styles for the container of the game, defining maximum width and margin for centering.

classes.name: game-status
classes.description: Styles for displaying the current game status with specific font size and color.

classes.name: game-board
classes.description: Grid styles for the game board layout including responsive design features.

classes.name: square
classes.description: Styles for individual squares in the game board, including cursor effects and transitions.

classes.name: game-controls
classes.description: Styles for the game controls section.

classes.name: button
classes.description: Styles for buttons in the game, including hover effects.

classes.name: game-title
classes.description: Styles for the title of the game with specific font settings.
